card.name: Verb after a drug name before passage claims
card.fires_on: The small verb or adverb right after a drug name (e.g. clindamycin does <<not>>, barbiturates <<readily>>), where the sentence is about how the drug moves through or crosses body barriers or its properties.

modes.label: Diffusion into CSF

modes.label: Crossing or binding
modes.description: Adverb or verb after a drug name before a statement about crossing the placenta or protein binding.
modes.example: Following oral or parenteral administration, barbiturates<< readily>> cross the placental barrier and are distributed

modes.label: Is/are after drug name
modes.description: Linking verb after a drug name leading into a property or contraindication statement.
modes.example: Penicillin G<< is>> relatively nontoxic, and dosage adjustments
